headline: IRIS Business releases latest investor presentation
hook: IRIS Business updates its investor outlook
summary: IRIS Business Services has submitted its latest investor presentation to the NSE. The document outlines the company's current operational status and strategic outlook. Retail investors can review these materials on the exchange website to understand the company's growth trajectory and financial positioning.
why_it_matters: Provides updated management commentary on company performance and future strategy.

headline: IRIS RegTech reports 35% revenue growth in Q2 FY27
hook: SaaS growth fuels IRIS RegTech revenue surge
summary: IRIS RegTech Solutions announced a 35% year-on-year revenue increase for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company attributed this performance to strong momentum in its SaaS business and growth in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR). The results highlight the firm's expanding footprint in the regulatory technology space.
why_it_matters: Strong SaaS revenue growth signals potential for sustained long-term earnings.
